name: Pine Scripts
tagline: Paste a Pine Script indicator and chart it on any ticker
description: Paste a Pine Script v5 or v6 indicator and see it on Gloom charts for any ticker, in the terminal and the desktop app. Overlay scripts draw on the price, others in a panel of their own. Scripts are saved with your profile, run on your machine, and appear in the data catalog and the chart's add-series search.
